- Copy the value= (or date=) string, or a short span from HYBRID EXCERPTS; light cleanup of whitespace is OK.
- Do NOT return null if at least one listed value or hybrid excerpt plausibly matches the definition.
- null ONLY when every listed item and hybrid excerpt is clearly wrong for this field.
- Never invent identifiers/dates/prices absent from the evidence.

- Do NOT return null if at least one listed value or hybrid excerpt plausibly matches the definition.
- null ONLY when every listed item and hybrid excerpt is clearly wrong for this field.
- Never invent identifiers/dates/prices absent from the evidence.
